main.description: Get the lines this host logged, oldest first, as it wrote them to its output: one request's by its trace, or the last of a message, a level or a duration. Only the accounts the host names as its operators may ask, by service auth.

trace.description: Every line logged while answering one request: the x-trace-id it was answered with.

message.description: Only lines with this message, such as request or mcp tool.

level.description: Only lines at this level or above.

minMs.description: Only lines that took this many milliseconds or more.

limit.description: How many lines, the last of them: 100 unless asked, or for a trace, 500.

line.description: The line, as the host logged it: its timestamp, level, fields and the spans it was logged in.
